2 WINDOW: mark mu-intervals with a finite-period attractor -> the windows of order
3 RG CLASSIFY: per window fit local rescaling (alpha, delta); assign RG level and parent window
4 WAKE: per window locate the adjacent crisis / lambda sign-flip boundary; tag with the window's RG level
5 LIFT TO 3-D: add the third axis; repeat 1-4 per slice; track how window orderings RECONNECT across slices
6 UNS MAP: mark bi/trifurcation events (prime activations forking the birth stream); per-generation window ordering
7 FACTOR READ (optional): for N locate its birth window (gen pi(gpf(N)), bifurcation of its primes); report RG-navigation path + wake; STATE entry point yes/no
